title: Hearty Nutty British Sausages Bangers And Mash
description: A classic British dish featuring nutty sausages, creamy mash, and a hint of tabasco sauce, made jain-friendly by using vegetable-based ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Render the lardons in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the lardons from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until softened.
Add the vegetarian sausages to the pan and cook until browned.
Add the vegetable broth, tabasco sauce, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, boil the chopped potatoes in a large pot of salted water until tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash with butter and a splash of vegetable broth.
Serve the sausages and lardons over the mashed potatoes.
